title: Sausage and Peppers
subtitle: One pan, minimal dishes
description: One pan, minimal dishes. Sized for a full crew, with timing that still works when the kitchen gets interrupted.

steps.title: Heat oven and prep pans
steps.instruction: Preheat 425°F. Toss chicken and veg with oil and seasoning on two rimmed pans — single layer only or you'll steam.

steps.title: Roast until charred
steps.instruction: Roast 18–22 minutes, swap racks halfway, until chicken reads 165°F and peppers have blistered edges.

steps.title: Serve family-style
steps.instruction: Pile Sausage and Peppers onto trays. Hold backup pan foil-covered at 200°F. Squeeze lime at the line if using.

steps.title: Batch the next pan
steps.instruction: While the crew eats, start a second batch on clean pans if you're feeding stragglers. Scrape burned bits — they smoke up the hall.

proTips: Prep all mise en place before the bell — this meal wins on organization, not speed hacks.
Keep a backup tray warm in the oven for late calls — nothing worse than cold plates after a run.
Taste for salt at the end — hall palates run salty after long shifts.
tonightSpread: Plate Sausage and Peppers with sides in separate pans so the crew can mix portions.
Line up Sausage and Peppers on the main counter with serving spoons — firefighters grab fast between calls.
Keep a backup tray warm in the oven at 200°F for late arrivals after a run.
leftovers: Cool leftovers in shallow containers within two hours — deep pots stay hot too long.
Label trays with date and reheat to 165°F minimum before second shift.
whyCrewsLikeIt: One pan, minimal dishes. A hall pick for tight shifts — one line, real portions, no drama at the stove.
mealPrepNotes: Minimal prep — chop aromatics before shift change so you can cook as soon as the board quiets.
